_note: SpeedKills' profile (src/game/game.ts, docs/PHASE_18_PLAN_SPEEDKILLS.md): what is in play and the design that differs from the legacy game, as the owner decided it on 2026-09-26. Selection and design only: the numbers that describe a thing stay in that thing's config. A gun here is a legacy gun (`from` in the plan) with its own name, family, role and fixed optic. Every id named here must exist (tools/checks/games.ts).
name: SpeedKills
_roster: Ten guns, two a family where there are two: a hard-hitter and a fast one. Five carry the owner's friends' names. USSO is the fastest gun in the game and the hardest to control; ANAKIN the steady SMG; BOOG the sniper, whose headshot always kills.
_weapons: Each gun's SpeedKills name, its role in its pair (hard or fast), and the one optic it always wears: attachments are off, fusion is the upgrade.
_ammo: Infinite reserve: every gun reloads forever and NOVA cools instead. Loot is guns and hacks only.
_fusion: The owner's numbers: a gun on the floor is level 0, and each of five fusions adds 2% damage and 10% magazine, to +10% and +50% at level 5; reload time and recoil come down 4% a level. A copy of a higher level than yours raises yours to its level. A duplicate hack lowers that hack's cooldown by cooldownStep a level, to abilityLevels.
_abilities: Ten hacks in two slots: pick one mobility and one utility before the match; in the battle royale, hacks on the floor fuse (the same one) or swap (another of the slot). `from` is the legacy ability each is built on; null is new. No passives, no ultimates.

set.name: DASH
set.blurb: A fast blink the way you look.

set.name: SLAM
set.blurb: Up, then down onto a spot, hurting whoever is under it.

set.name: LEAP
set.blurb: Straight up about four storeys, then glide.

set.name: GRAPPLE
set.blurb: A line that pulls you to a surface.

set.name: HEAL
set.blurb: A healing area for you and your squad.

set.name: ARMOR
set.blurb: Take much less damage for a moment, moving slower.

set.name: INVISIBILITY
set.blurb: Nearly unseen for a few seconds. Firing ends it.

set.name: REVEAL
set.blurb: Shows enemies in front of you through walls.

set.name: MINE
set.blurb: A mine that homes in on an enemy close by.

_life: No knockdowns; the first death goes to the Gulag, a later one makes a ghost, revived by a squad mate at its echo marker in reviveSeconds, awaySlowdown times as long while the ghost is further than followRadius metres from the reviver; two ghost revives a match. A squad is out when none of it is alive or in the Gulag. In solo a second death is the end.
_health: 100 health and 50 shield. The shield starts back shieldDelay seconds after the last damage and fills in shieldFill; health comes back at healthRegen a second after healthDelay. No heal items, no armour loot.
_match: The battle royale: up to maxPlayers in squads of team by default, about 6 to 7 minutes long (the owner's numbers). teams are the lobby's sizes as br.json's teams are, the bot counts each a whole number of squads with the default filling the match to 30 with your squad; bleed 0 is no knockdowns (a death is a death: the Gulag and the ghost are the second chances).
_bots: Five tiers, easiest first; casual, skilled and advanced are the legacy easy, normal and hard, beginner and extreme are new.
_lists: The lists the legacy game keeps in its own configs, in SpeedKills' guns: what the bots carry (every gun, in turn), the six default loadouts' two guns (the order of the legacy defaults: Assault, Close Quarters, Marksman, Heavy, Sidearms, Dirt Bike), and the Gulag's pool, from which the two fighters' shared pair is drawn.
